notes: καί inside the τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί idiom is left unrepresented; *with* is read as realizing the dative σοί, and rule 68 puts the supplied *have … to do* on the first dative pronoun.
ὁ ἅγιος takes *the … One* headed on the supplied nominal under rules 49 and 102, leaving the adjective bare — the same shape as τὸ τρίτον → *the … part* / *third*.
